serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Sorry {f_botName}, but I need to take this.
You: Hey, what’s up Big Daddy! How are you?
It’s unusual for him to call me. I wonder what’s that about.
Big Daddy: What’s up little one. We were supposed to go to a restaurant, don’t you remember?
You: Yeah, I remember, but we really didn’t set up a date.
Big Daddy: We didn’t?
You: No…
Big Daddy: But my assistant did call you though, right?
You: No?
Big Daddy: Damn…
Big Daddy: So. {{wi}}Are you ready to go?
You: No! My hair is messy and shit.
Big Daddy: Don’t worry about small stuff, besides, I took some precautions.
Big Daddy: We aren’t going anywhere fancy. I didn’t want you to feel overwhelmed by a higher class environment. I chose a place in which you would feel more comfortable.
You: That’s great. {{wi}}I guess…
Big Daddy: Anyway, I’m in front of your door right now. Are you ready to go?
You: …
You: Give me a moment…
